enforcement_note: No hook can read a plan and decide whether its problem statement is separable from its solution. The real mechanism is the agent working the questions at Phase 1 and the user reading the answers before approving the plan.
condition: Deciding how a task will be shown to be done.
rule: Ask how this will be proven, and whether the proof could fail, as questions.
ai_action: Work through the checklist against the plan, before the work begins. Report the answers, including the ones that pass. Where the plan simply does not address an item, say so -- an absent answer is the finding, not a reason to skip the item.

checklist.question: Is the way this will be verified decided before the work starts, rather than after?
checklist.remediation_hint: Write the check into the plan alongside the criterion it settles.

checklist.question: Can the proposed check actually fail -- has it been run against the unfixed state?
checklist.remediation_hint: Run it before the fix and record the failure count.

checklist.question: Does verification cover the acceptance criteria, or only the parts that were easy to test?
checklist.remediation_hint: Map each criterion to the check that settles it; the unmapped ones are the gap.
checklist.group_condition: When the plan has more than a handful of criteria

checklist.question: Is there a check for the failure this plan is meant to prevent, not only for the feature it adds?
checklist.remediation_hint: Add the regression case that reproduces the original failure.
checklist.group_condition: When the plan has more than a handful of criteria

checklist.question: Does anything other than the author's assertion confirm the work is done?
checklist.remediation_hint: Name the independent signal: a test, a reviewer, a measurement.

checklist.question: Is 'did we do a good enough job' scheduled as a step, rather than left to memory?
checklist.remediation_hint: Add the retrospective to the plan's closing phase.

anti_pattern: Do not convert these questions into prescriptions, and do not answer them from the plan's own summary. A plan review reads the plan looking for what is absent; a summary is written by the same author and repeats what is present.

provenance.source: agent-generated; every item cites a source resolved on 2026-08-05
provenance.basis: Plan-review gap: .ai/05-domains/ reviews code that already exists, so a plan was reviewed by nothing. Items phrased as review questions per the checklist-not-prescription rule.

note: Verification designed after the work tends to verify what was built, not what was wanted.
